name: motorize
description: MOTORIZE — Plataforma de cadastro e credenciamento de motociclistas de entrega (Toritama/PE)

scripts.setup: node scripts/preparar.mjs && npm run db:migrate -w apps/api && npm run db:seed -w apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,app,painel -c blue,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/app" "npm run dev -w apps/painel"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/app && npm run build -w apps/painel
